source_review:
# R7 private MV storage proof (frozen V1)

Base: merged PR19 `10f4a6ae956e881e8d9e85a4797c55a441cd27c3`. Pinned decoder comparison: dav1d `b546257f770768b2c88258c533da38b91a06f737`, `src/decode.c:3571–3610` creates MV storage only for inter/switch or intrabc; `3685–3692` retains it across refreshed reference slots.

The high-level `Decoder` constructor alone calls a free internal-package enable function. Its state and tile callbacks are unexported; decoded image outputs contain no MV-grid pointers. Public/manual `FrameWorkState`, callback users, and layered/shared-state routing retain the old independent grid copies. No method is added to the public alias.

The nine original MV backing allocations remain nine buffers. A completed grid stays immutable while any of eight slots holds its one-based handle. A new frame takes an unreferenced buffer, with one current hold, so eight distinct slots plus one current frame are sufficient. Publishing adds slot holds; replacing slots releases old holds; successful finish or abort releases current. Failure before publication retains the old references; failed prepare releases its private current hold. Reset drops all descriptors/holds but preserves capacity and private mode. No new warm allocation is permitted.

Ordinary key/intra-only frames with no intrabc and no temporal-reference flag omit current-grid initialization, block-loop invalid-entry marks and saved-grid copies. Refreshed slots still receive valid intra-only order-hint metadata, replacing any old inter grid. Resolution passes a NON-NIL empty descriptor: temporal Setup uses reference presence for LastOverlay/RefStamp, then projectSetupReference checks IntraOnly before reading/validating payload. Intrabc still receives a current grid; mixed intra blocks inside an inter frame are unchanged. Shared-store and show-existing frames acquire no private grid.

The frozen original prepare/publish oracle compares 48 frames with zero/single/multi/all refresh masks, size changes and intra/inter transitions. It compares projection payloads and Setup counters, not only final saved arrays. Separate tests prove private sharing and next-frame nonaliasing, default mutable-slot isolation, capacity-nine reuse, Reset, zero warm allocation, failed reference/projection setup, successful and failed abort/finish, shared/show-existing and intrabc fallback. Focused run passed in 0.370s. Production block arithmetic, rounding, candidate order, CDFs and output handling are unchanged.

Screen policy is fixed in freeze-v1.json: three paired warm rounds of two affected clips, 15 full-clip operations, all slash components anchored, exactly one expected row per invocation, no retries/exclusions. At least one case must save >=0.5% paired GM with >=2/3 wins; neither may regress >1%; zero warm allocations. The fixed screen passed; pair variability and exact results are in the summary.
